title: Coinbase may debut prediction markets, tokenized stocks on Wednesday: Report
summary: Coinbase will showcase its new products on a livestream next week after joining a prediction market coalition with Kalshi and other US operators, Bloomberg reported.

title: Standard Chartered, AirAsia parent to test ringgit stablecoin in Malaysia
summary: Standard Chartered Malaysia and AirAsia parent Capital A plan to issue and test a ringgit-pegged stablecoin for wholesale applications.

title: Bitcoin new year bear flag sparks $76K BTC price target next
summary: Bitcoin price targets included $76,000 and $50,000, thanks to growing bearish BTC price divergences and a lack of upward price momentum.

title: CFTC gives prediction markets leeway on data and record-keeping rules
summary: The CFTC gave “no-action” letters to a group of prediction markets, including Polymarket US, exempting them from swap data reporting and record-keeping regulations.

title: Web3 gaming shifts to sustainability as confidence returns: BGA
summary: The Blockchain Game Alliance reports industry confidence rose to 66% as developers pivoted from speculation to sustainable models following a funding collapse since 2021.

title: CFTC pulls ‘actual delivery’ crypto guidance, giving flexibility to exchanges
summary: The CFTC has scrapped its guidance on how crypto is delivered in a transaction, giving “way more flexibility for exchanges,” says StarkWare's Katherine Kirkpatrick Bos.

title: YouTube enables PYUSD stablecoin payouts for US creators: Report
summary: Fortune reported that YouTube is allowing creators to be paid in PayPal's stablecoin, a potential boon for adoption due to the platform's size.

title: Bitcoin bounces on Fed rate cut with bigger rally ahead predicted
summary: Crypto markets rebounded after the Fed’s third rate cut this year, with analysts predicting a larger bounce following the typical post-cut pattern.

title: Binance cozies up to Trump’s crypto platform with USD1 stablecoin links
summary: Binance added a host of zero-fee trading pairs for the Trump family’s stablecoin and used it to back its own stablecoin collateral.

title: SEC clears DTCC to offer securities market tokenization service
summary: The Depository Trust and Clearing Corporation plans to tokenize stocks, ETFs and US Treasurys next year after receiving an SEC no-action letter.
